fact: A workshop on 15 October 2026 opened scoping of a MINDCAF digitalisation project with Orange Cameroun, with a preliminary 2026-2030 roadmap (deployment envisaged 2028) for a shared platform including document management, GIS, cadastral tools and an online services portal.
title: Foncier : le MINDCAF et Orange Cameroun préparent la mutation numérique de l'administration
